jobs.title: Senior RF Radar Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR RF RADAR ENGINEER I

Based at Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, we are looking for a Senior RF Engineer II - Radar/RF who will be responsible for the technical development of radar and RF systems including SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) and space-based radar applications. You will drive radar system architecture, oversee RF component integration, and support hands-on radar testing and calibration. The successful candidate will have a strong combination of radar engineering, RF systems design, and spacecraft systems experience, and will thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

System Development

• Lead technical development of space-based radar systems including architecture design, prototyping, integration, test, and flight development

• Define and maintain radar performance requirements and link budget specifications accounting for orbital parameters

• Conduct radar payload design trades including antenna selection, waveform optimization, and processing architectures for space platforms

• Drive key technical decisions for radar modes, timing, PRF selection, and RF chain design considering orbit dynamics

• Complete radar analyses including range/Doppler resolution, SNR, ambiguity analysis, interference assessment, and orbital effects on performance

• Analyze mission requirements including orbit selection, ground track patterns, and revisit characteristics

• Develop and execute radar calibration strategies and image quality validation methods for spaceborne systems

• Support the development of radar test plans, procedures, and automated test systems

• Lead the design and development of radar GSE including calibration sources and test fixtures

• Support spacecraft integration activities and interface with bus subsystem teams (power, thermal, ADCS, data handling)

• Support the development of product documentation including ICDs, test reports, and User Manuals

Radar & RF Engineering

• Design and analyze radar waveforms for various space-based imaging and detection applications

• Perform radar system modeling and simulation using tools such as MATLAB, STK, or custom codes including orbital propagation

• Assess and integrate COTS RF components for space-qualified radar transmit/receive chains

• Support hands-on radar testing including EIRP measurements, receiver sensitivity, etc.

• Interface with multidisciplinary teams including RF, digital, mechanical, thermal, structural, and software engineers

Customer/Program Support

• Review proposals and requirements specifications for space-based radar payload opportunities

• Scope and drive development activities for new radar capabilities

• Support engineering reviews such as PDRs, CDRs and TRRs

• Provide technical support to internal/external customers including radar performance troubleshooting

• Maintain broad awareness of product development and production schedules

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or related field

• 5+ years of relevant experience

• Hands-on experience with space-based radar systems including system integration and mission operations, including imaging modes, processing, and performance assessment

• Strong understanding of orbital mechanics and spacecraft systems including how orbit parameters affect radar performance

• Working knowledge of spacecraft subsystems including power, thermal, ADCS, and their impact on radar payload design

• Strong radar system knowledge including waveform design, pulse compression, and Doppler processing

• Solid theoretical and practical understanding of RF systems including link budgets, linearity, and noise analysis

• Experience developing and delivering radar/RF systems from requirements through testing for space applications

• Proficiency with radar simulation tools and orbital analysis software

• Experience with radar testing including range measurements and RF performance characterization

• U.S. citizenship is required due to program requirements

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD TS/SCI clearance

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Existing DoD TS/SCI clearance

• Extensive experience in space-grade radar system design and environmental testing

• Knowledge of advanced SAR techniques (GMTI, InSAR, polarimetry) for space platforms

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$152,275—$233,675 USD

Base Salary

$132,000—$198,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. We are looking to add a Project / Process Engineering Manager - Capital Projects and Process Improvements to the team! This position is responsible for leading the development, facilitation, and implementation of the Capital Equipment and Process improvements for all manufacturing locations company wide. This position will work closely with operations leadership, plant personnel, and continuous improvement teams at both the business unit and corporate level. Responsibilities will also include designing and delivering capital equipment improvements, analyzing processes, metrics and results, and implementing strategies as necessary.

This position may require travel between 30% to 50% both domestically and internationally.

• Manage major multi-million-dollar capital projects companywide including equipment research, layout design, identification and comparison of equipment options and configurations.
• Manage the estimating, capability analysis and implementation of equipment additions and improvements.
• Develop, utilize and update complex spreadsheets and project management tools to track assets, capabilities, condition, age and replacement plans across the worldwide manufacturing platform.
• Create detailed models and testing protocols to compare new equipment technologies as they are introduced to facilitate the asset selection process.

• Roll out existing CI training programs including but not limited to 5S, make a ready reduction, Kaizen, and value stream mapping
• Develop baselines for future comparisons. Work with IT as needed to modify or expand appropriate data to be captured and measured.
• Provide ongoing feedback regarding goals and plans. Oversee the completion, compilation, and analysis of results to ensure effective program implementation.
• Collaborate with others to ensure the applicability and effectiveness of the process and capital improvements across multiple functional areas.
• Other responsibilities as assigned based on skillset and business needs.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
• 5+ years of experience supporting or working in a manufacturing environment.
• Major Capital Equipment Management experience
• Building, HVAC and power system experience
• Capital and general engineering project management experience.
• Print and Packaging experience preferred
• Digital and Offset Printing experience preferred.
• Manufacturing management experience preferred.
• Experienced in the use of CI tools and capable of training others in their use is preferred.

Required Skills

• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Must have excellent change management and interpersonal skills.

• Good grasp of manufacturing processes, operations, and plant key performance indicators
• Self-motivated and driven to achieve results

jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Mobile Phlebotomy & Logistics Specialist (Contract) will serve as an essential team member supporting diagnostic testing coordination for Mt Sinai transplant patients.  This full-time contractor will help facilitate the collection, packaging, and transport of blood samples for CareDx diagnostic tests and ensure that those samples are properly prepared for secure return shipment to the CareDx central laboratory for analysis.

The Mobile Phlebotomy & Logistics Specialist will collaborate with center personnel and internal CareDx departments, ensuring seamless support of clinical workflows and maintaining strict compliance with regulatory and internal quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Phlebotomy Services
• Perform venipuncture and specimen collection procedures according to CareDx protocols and industry best practices.
• Verify patient identity and ensure accurate completion of required documentation.
• Review test requisitions and collection requirements prior to specimen collection.
• Label, package, and prepare specimens for transport according to established procedures.
• Maintain specimen integrity through proper handling, storage, and transportation practices.
• Educate patients regarding specimen collection procedures and answer routine questions.
• Provide compassionate, professional service that supports a positive patient experience.
• Identify and escalate collection issues, patient concerns, or specimen quality risks.
Courier and Logistics Support
• Transport biological specimens, testing kits, supplies, and documentation between collection sites, laboratories, shipping facilities, and designated locations.
• Ensure all specimens are delivered within required timeframes and temperature requirements.
• Maintain chain-of-custody documentation and transportation records.
• Coordinate specimen drop-offs with laboratories, processing facilities, and shipping partners.
Quality and Compliance
• Follow all HIPAA, OSHA, CLIA, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
• Adhere to all CareDx policies, procedures, and quality requirements.
• Complete required documentation accurately and timely.
• Participate in training, competency assessments, and continuing education activities.
• Report specimen collection, transportation, safety, or quality issues promptly.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant work environment.

Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• Completion of an accredited phlebotomy training program.
• Current Phlebotomy Certification (CPT, PBT, or equivalent) preferred.
• Minimum 1 year of phlebotomy experience required.
• Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
• Reliable personal transportation.
• Ability to travel extensively within assigned geographic territory.
• Strong interpersonal, customer service, and communication skills.
• Basic computer and mobile technology proficiency.
• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a senior backend software engineer to help build the app conversion signals that power Reddit’s app advertising business. You will work on MMP integrations, SKAN processing, and App CAPI to make app installs and in-app events more reliable, useful, and easier for advertisers to integrate.

Role Description:

Advertisers depend on conversion signals to understand campaign performance and guide investment. Missing events, duplicate delivery, inconsistent mappings, and difficult integrations can undermine that trust. Your work will improve the systems and diagnostics that make app signals usable for measurement and downstream ads systems.

• Analyze signal quality and delivery metrics, investigate discrepancies, and prioritize improvements with product and data science partners.

• Work with partner engineering and downstream consumers to evolve schemas and integrations without disrupting existing advertisers.

• Incorporate privacy and security requirements into system design, and maintain controls throughout the data lifecycle.

• Raise engineering quality through testing, design reviews, incident learning, and mentorship.

Required Qualifications:

• Demonstrated senior-level backend software engineering experience delivering and operating scalable production systems.

• Hands-on app ads signals or mobile measurement experience, with depth in MMP integrations, SKAN, or app conversion APIs.

jobs.title: Enterprise AI - Account Director - Consumer Packaged Goods
jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

Role: Enterprise AI - Account Director - Consumer Packaged Goods
Location: Dallas, TX, with client-site presence as required
Experience Level: 8+ years; consumer packaged goods experience highly desirable
Work Model: Hybrid, with regular client-site presence as required

Why Join Enterprise AI?

Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing focused on deploying AI systems that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

As the Enterprise AI Account Director for a consumer packaged goods company, you will own an established custom engineering relationship both commercially and operationally. You will expand the account by identifying operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows where AI can create measurable value, selling those deployments, and overseeing delivery through a senior Forward-Deployed Engineer or delivery lead.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who combines commercial instinct, enterprise credibility, and delivery leadership.

As the Enterprise AI Account Director, You Will

Expand the Client Relationship

Build relationships across multiple buying centers and identify new sponsors and decision-makers beyond the current buyer.

Identify AI Deployment Opportunities

Assess the client’s operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows to identify two or three quantified opportunities where AI deployment can create measurable value.

Sell Follow-On Work

Translate identified opportunities into clear scopes of work and lead the expansion from discovery through client alignment and signed SOWs.

Own Delivery Quality

Maintain single-point accountability for the client relationship and business outcome. Oversee the embedded delivery team through a senior FDE lead or delivery lead.

Manage Commercial Performance

Own SOWs, pricing, margin, and delivery quality. Establish a written scope baseline and weekly issue log to maintain alignment across the client and delivery teams.

Build Reusable Capabilities

Harvest at least one reusable component from the engagement for Turing’s Enterprise AI platform.

The Anti-Sell

Commercial and delivery ownership: This is not a pure delivery or project management role. You will be expected to identify opportunities, sell follow-on work, own commercial terms, and remain accountable for the client relationship and outcome.

Regular client presence: The role requires a willingness to work on site with the client regularly.

High accountability: You will be responsible for connecting account expansion, commercial execution, and delivery quality.

Our Enterprise AI Account Directors Typically Have

Consumer packaged goods experience: Experience working in the consumer packaged goods industry, particularly with clients or operations based in the Dallas area, is highly desirable.

Deep enterprise account ownership: Typically 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology delivery or consulting, with a track record of owning a named client relationship.

Commercial expansion experience: Experience expanding an enterprise account across multiple buying centers and selling follow-on work, not only delivering initially defined projects. You should be comfortable owning SOWs, pricing, margin, and account growth.

End-to-end delivery leadership: Experience overseeing delivery teams and maintaining single-point accountability for the client relationship, business outcome, and delivery quality.

Recent AI or data deployment experience: Experience with AI or data deployments within the last two years, along with the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders, open conversations with new sponsors, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly across commercial, operational, and technical teams.

Candidates whose experience is limited to delivery or project management without commercial ownership, or who lack recent AI or data deployment experience, will not be a fit for this role.

Values

• We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

• We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

• We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

• Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

• Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

• Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.

• Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

• Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace  and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Storage
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

You will be contributing to both our open source server https://github.com/supabase/storage and upstream dependencies we use, like the TUS server https://github.com/tus/tus-node-server/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Afenos+is%3Amerged.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake

 - Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

 - Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation

 - Improve the performance, observability, and reliability of our storage server

 - Work with the frontend team to build a fast, powerful storage explorer

 - Improve our APIs, client libraries and CLI to provide an exceptional end-to-end DX for our users

 - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years backend engineering experience of running Node.js in production

 - Have experience with highly scalable, distributed systems

 - Are comfortable with working across the stack - backend application development, some infrastructure work including deploying, monitoring and scaling the service

 - Posses familiarity with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and performance tuning

 - Have experience with production-grade PostgreSQL usage, including tuning and troubleshooting

 - Demonstrate an ownership mentality: driving projects end-to-end

 - Display empathy towards developer experience
   


NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Prior experience working on developer tools

 - Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

 - Direct experience designing and operating large file upload/download pipelines at scale

 - Deep, practical CDN integration and optimization knowledge

 - Experience with image and video processing tools (sharp, dssim, ffmpeg), formats and codecs (AVIF, WebM, Brotli) is a plus

 - Experience with the frontend ecosystem (Next.js, React, etc) is a plus


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Data API Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data API Engineer to join our Data API Team and help improve the feature set, reliability and performance of our Data API, based on the PostgREST project.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Work on PostgREST’s PostgreSQL driver (based on Hasql) and remove bottlenecks and improve it’s performance.

 - Work on PostgREST development of new features and bug fixes, aligned towards the goal of a multitenant Data API.

 - Resolve incidents and escalated support issues, while also improving observability and performance.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to debug and solve integration issues with the Supabase platform.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Strong Haskell skills with at least 3 years of experience.

 - Experience using the C language.

 - Solid knowledge of SQL and plpgsql scripting in PostgreSQL.

 - Strong track record of contributing to and engaging with open-source projects. Bonus points if you’ve maintained an open source project.

 - Strong experience with providing technical support to users with varying levels of technical expertise.

 - Experience with debugging applications under the Linux operating system.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Senior Embryologist - Reproductive Infertility Clinic Full time Days
jobs.description:
The Senior Embryologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine (NM). This position adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program and complies with all applicable policies, procedures, guidelines, and regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Embryologist  is responsible for performing embryology laboratory procedures related to assisted reproductive technology (ART). Key responsibilities include microscopic identification of oocytes from follicular fluid, assessment of oocyte maturity, insemination, fertilization evaluation, embryo culture and grading, preparation of embryos for transfer, assisted hatching, and cryopreservation and warming of gametes and embryos. This role also includes performing semen analysis and sperm preparation for in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intrauterine insemination (IUI).

Responsibilities:

• Perform ART laboratory procedures accurately and consistently, including oocyte identification, insemination, fertilization assessment, embryo culture, grading, and preparation for transfer.
• Conduct cryopreservation and warming of gametes and embryos using established protocols.
• Perform semen analysis and sperm preparation for IVF and IUI procedures.
• Ensure laboratory work is completed correctly, reliably, and in accordance with established standards.
• Communicate laboratory findings and, when appropriate, interpret results for physicians, nurses, and patients.
• Assist the laboratory director with data collection, analysis, and reporting activities.
• Accurately document, interpret (as appropriate), and report results to ordering physicians and the laboratory director in a timely manner.
• Maintain accurate, secure, and confidential patient records in compliance with applicable regulations.
• Conduct routine inventory assessments and order supplies and equipment necessary for laboratory operations.
• Monitor cryostorage systems, respond promptly to alarms or irregular conditions, and escalate issues as needed.
• Notify the laboratory director of patient or physician inquiries, including urgent fertility preservation requests (e.g., oncology patients).
• Perform daily quality control procedures and ensure compliance with laboratory and regulatory standards.
• Participate in quality improvement initiatives within the laboratory and organization.
• Engage in continuing education and professional development activities.
• Support additional laboratory or operational responsibilities as assigned.

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science (medical technology).
• Minimum of two (2) years of laboratory experience.
• Experience with sterile/aseptic laboratory techniques.

Preferred:

• Experience in human or animal assisted reproductive technology (ART) laboratory settings.

jobs.title: Oracle Procurement Expert (AI Procurement Integration)
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIO

Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises.

Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale.

At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies.

Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI.

We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact.




THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Oracle Procurement Expert to own how Lio integrates with Oracle environments across our enterprise customers.

Many of the world's largest organizations run their procurement and financial operations on Oracle. To make AI agents work in these environments, we need deep technical expertise, scalable integration architectures, and people who can turn complex enterprise requirements into working solutions.

You'll become our go-to expert for Oracle Procurement, working directly with customers, engineers, and implementation teams to design, build, and scale integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud and Oracle E-Business Suite.

This isn't a traditional consulting role. You'll own solutions end-to-end, from architecture discussions with enterprise stakeholders to hands-on configuration, debugging, and production deployment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own our Oracle integration strategy: Define integration patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards across Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement and Oracle E-Business Suite.

 - Build enterprise-grade integrations: Design and implement data flows using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, BI Publisher, OTBI, and cXML.

 - Work directly with enterprise customers: Lead technical workshops with procurement teams, IT stakeholders, and implementation partners to translate complex business requirements into scalable solutions.

 - Get hands-on: Configure integrations, troubleshoot interface errors, resolve data inconsistencies, and support deployments from testing through go-live.

 - Connect AI with enterprise procurement: Enable our agents to interact with requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, supplier data, catalogs, and invoices.

 - Shape our product: Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to turn customer-specific integration challenges into reusable product capabilities.

 - Build internal expertise: Develop documentation, playbooks, and best practices while supporting our implementation teams and external partners.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of hands-on Oracle experience, with deep expertise in enterprise procurement.

 - Strong experience implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement and/or Oracle E-Business Suite, ideally across multiple enterprise projects.

 - Solid understanding of procurement processes, including Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Source-to-Contract (S2C), purchasing, and invoice processing.

 - Experience integrating Oracle Procurement with Financials, Supply Chain, and external applications.

 - Technical proficiency with OIC, Oracle APIs, FBDI, SQL, data mappings, and integration troubleshooting.

 - Experience owning technical workstreams or solution architecture in complex enterprise environments.

 - Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with senior enterprise stakeholders.

 - A hands-on mindset: you're equally comfortable discussing architecture with a CIO and debugging a production issue.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with both Oracle Fusion Cloud and EBS, including migration projects.

 - Oracle Procurement Cloud or OIC certifications.

 - Experience with other procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or Jaggaer.

 - Scripting experience, particularly Python.

 - Exposure to AI, intelligent automation, or document-processing technologies.


WHY JOIN LIO?

 - Own a critical technical domain: Become the Oracle authority and directly shape our enterprise integration capabilities.

 - Build real-world AI: Bring AI agents into production at some of the world's largest organizations.

 - Shape our US expansion: Join our growing New York team and help establish how we deliver enterprise AI across the US market.

 - High ownership, real impact: Your work will directly influence our product, customer implementations, and technical strategy.

 - Move fast: Work alongside ambitious engineers and operators in an environment with high standards, trust, and minimal bureaucracy.

If you're excited about combining deep Oracle expertise with cutting-edge AI, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Factory Technician - Weekday Second Shift
jobs.description:
Factory Technician - Weekday Second Shift | Nox Metals | Detroit, MI

 

About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.

 

The role. We're hiring Factory Technicians to cut, inspect, and ship the aluminum our aerospace and defense customers build with. You will run our saws to cut plate, bar, and rounds to spec. Every cut gets measured, every job gets logged, and every shipment goes out right.

This is a hands on job with real equipment and real software. We'll train and certify you, and you'll learn how a modern metals operation runs from receiving to shipping. You report to your Shift Lead.

If you've worked in a factory, a metals shop, or a skilled trade and you want to work somewhere that moves fast, this is your next step.

 

Shift hours:

Weekdays, Second Shift: Monday through Thursday, 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM (with availability for early mornings, late nights, and additional days as needed)

 

You will:

· Operate industrial saws, bandsaws, CNC equipment, and material handling systems

· Load, measure, cut, and inspect aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to spec

· Run forklifts and overhead cranes, we’ll train and certify you

· Follow cut lists and production schedules with precision

· Receive inbound material and verify against purchase orders

· Package, label, and stage outbound shipments

· Record cut data and job completions in our software systems, accurately, every time

· Look at every process and figure out how to make it better

· Keep the floor clean, organized, and ready for the next job

· Work safely every shift and hold your teammates to the same standard

· Complete other tasks as assigned

 

You are:

· Knowledgeable or experienced in a factory, metals center, or with skilled trades

· Committed to safety

· Attentive with regards to quality, every cut, every cert, every shipment

· Always thinking about how to make processes better

· Customer obsessed

· A team player with a good attitude

· Someone who takes ownership, if it is your shift, it is your responsibility

· Precise under pressure and reliable

· Comfortable with software

· Organized and detail oriented

· Able to lift up to 50 lbs., operate heavy equipment and be on your feet for a full shift with or without reasonable accommodation

· Not afraid to work outside normal hours when America demands it

 

Nice to have:

· Experience in metals, aluminum, or aerospace/defense supply chains

· Forklift and/or overhead crane certification

· Background in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

· Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter

 

Benefits:

· Equity in Nox Metals

· Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

 

This role is full time, in person in Detroit.

 

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Marketing
jobs.description:
Jellyfish is looking for a Head of Corporate Marketing to shape how we show up in the market and lead the conversation around AI's impact on software development. You'll own our brand, communications, editorial, analyst relations, social, and executive voice—turning proprietary data and insights into a compelling market narrative.

Reporting to the CMO, you'll build our market presence, and establish Jellyfish as a trusted authority among engineering leaders. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a builder who thrives on creating momentum and driving impact.

Let's talk about what you'll do:

 - Own our narrative: Partner with the CMO, CEO, Research, and Product Marketing to define our market positioning and turn proprietary insights into compelling stories.

 - Drive market influence: Lead PR, analyst relations, executive communications, and thought leadership to elevate Jellyfish's visibility and credibility.

 - Build our content engine: Oversee editorial strategy, research releases, and a consistent corporate news calendar that drives market engagement.

 - Elevate our brand: Own brand identity, messaging, and creative direction across channels.

 - Lead modern discovery: Connect organic search, AI-driven discovery, and social media to expand our reach and influence.

 - Build and lead the team: Develop a high-performing corporate marketing function, leveraging AI to increase efficiency and impact.

 - Measure success: Own share of voice and track brand influence, message adoption, and contribution to demand creation.

Let’s talk about what you need to excel:

 - 10+ years in corporate marketing, communications, or brand, including 5+ years leading teams in B2B technology.

 - Experience building compelling narratives and elevating brands during periods of market or category transformation.

 - Strong understanding of technical audiences, ideally engineering leaders and developers.

 - Proven success across PR, content, brand, analyst relations, and executive communications.

A list of job experiences and qualification requirements is great, but humility, a performance-driven attitude, and a team-player approach are most important to us. We love to have fun and win in the process. We only hire people who have a passion for building great companies in an environment where a sense of humor is a must.

Occasional travel may be required.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.



Let’s talk about us!
This is all about you, but you want to know a little about us. Jellyfish https://jellyfish.co is the leading intelligence platform for AI-Integrated engineering, helping more than 1,000 companies including DraftKings, Keller Williams and Blue Yonder, leverage AI to transform how they build software. By combining the industry’s deepest engineering dataset with context-rich intelligence, Jellyfish helps R&D organizations understand what’s driving impact, adopt proven industry best practices, and make smarter decisions across AI adoption, planning, delivery, and engineering performance.

Pinterest is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Specialist II to support General & Administrative sourcing across Workplace Services, Legal & Business Affairs, Trust & Safety and Customer Support Operations. You’ll help run the sourcing lifecycle, from intake and market research through RFx, contracting and supplier management, partnering with leaders across Finance, Legal, Trust & Safety, People, IT, Workplace and Support. This role reports to the Sr. Manager, General & Administrative Strategic Sourcing and is open to candidates anywhere in the US (remote).

What you’ll do

• Support sourcing projects for assigned G&A categories, including intake, requirements gathering, market research, RFx coordination and supplier comparisons.

• Prepare spend, bid, supplier and market analyses and turn them into clear recommendations for the Sr. Manager and business partners.

• Support contracting and negotiation activity, including drafting and tracking agreements, renewals, pricing and service-level terms, with guidance from the Sr. Manager and in partnership with Legal.

• Administer supplier contracts day to day: monitor service levels and quality standards, resolve routine issues and escalate appropriately.

• Partner with stakeholders in Legal & Business Affairs, Trust & Safety, Workplace and Customer Support Operations to understand needs and keep projects on track.

• Keep sourcing and contract data accurate in procurement and contract-management systems, and contribute to category plans and process improvements.

• Use approved AI tools to accelerate research, documentation and reporting, while validating results and protecting sensitive information.

What we’re looking for

• Minimum 5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, contract management, category management or a related field.

• Experience supporting or executing RFx processes, supplier evaluation, contract administration or renewals.

• Ability to manage supplier relationships and contract terms and to communicate clearly with stakeholders.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze spend, bids or market data and present clear recommendations.

• Organized and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines and sound judgment on when to escalate.

• Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, analysis or documentation, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality, protecting sensitive data and maintaining ownership of final deliverables.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a technology, platform, SaaS or high-growth environment.

• Exposure to corporate-services categories such as workplace and facilities, legal and professional services, trust and safety or customer support vendors, contingent workforce, or HR and benefits.

• Experience with source-to-pay, contract-lifecycle-management or spend-analytics tools such as Zip, Oracle or Ironclad.

• CPSM, CIPS or progress toward a related professional certification.

Why this role is compelling

You will build hands-on experience across the full sourcing lifecycle in a high-visibility portfolio, learn directly from a senior sourcing leader, and work with partners across the company. The role has a clear path toward owning more complex projects, supplier relationships and categories, with room to build skills in negotiation, market analysis and responsible AI-enabled work.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Portfolio Corporate Accounts
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, Portfolio Corporate Accounts role is a key leadership position within U.S. Market Access, leading Sobi’s Corporate Account Director team and driving the company’s national strategy across integrated delivery networks (IDNs), hospitals, and health systems.

This leader will shape and execute a portfolio-wide approach to strategic corporate accounts, ensuring consistent and effective engagement with hospital executives, pharmacy and therapeutics (P&T) decision-makers, and other influential health-system stakeholders. The Senior Director will lead a high-performing team of Corporate Account Directors focused on expanding appropriate formulary access, supporting contracting strategies, and driving adoption across Sobi’s rare disease portfolio.

Working closely with partners across Market Access, Medical Affairs, Health Economics, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Compliance, the Senior Director will translate portfolio strategy into actionable account plans and ensure Sobi brings the right resources and expertise to its most important health-system customers.

This is an opportunity for an experienced strategic account leader to build and strengthen Sobi’s capabilities within the evolving IDN landscape while leading a team with national reach and meaningful impact for patients living with rare diseases.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate Account Director team by setting clear objectives, expectations, and accountability.
• Set national account priorities, account assignments, performance objectives, and measures of success aligned with Sobi’s portfolio strategy.
• Recruit, hire, onboard, and retain exceptional Corporate Account Directors to strengthen Sobi’s capabilities within the IDN and health-system landscape.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture grounded in Sobi’s values, leadership principles, and compliance standards.

Strategic Account Leadership

• Lead national IDN and health-system strategy across the Sobi portfolio, ensuring consistent, effective execution across priority accounts.
• Establish and maintain senior-level relationships with key IDN and health-system stakeholders, serving as an executive partner and escalation point for strategic accounts.
• Guide the Corporate Account Director team through hospital and health-system formulary processes and advance appropriate access to Sobi therapies.
• Coordinate the strategic deployment of cross-functional resources, including Medical Affairs and Health Economics, in support of priority accounts and customer needs.
• Translate marketplace and customer insights into recommendations that inform corporate account, Market Access, and broader commercial strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with senior stakeholders across Value & Access, Medical Affairs, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to develop and execute integrated IDN strategies.
• Support the development and approval of business cases associated with strategic account initiatives, programs, and sponsorships.
• Coordinate with cross-functional partners to support appropriate educational and marketing initiatives within IDNs and health systems.
• Ensure Corporate Account priorities and customer insights are represented in broader portfolio and commercial planning.

Performance Management & Insights

• Leverage account performance data, dashboards, and market insights to identify opportunities, prioritize strategic accounts, and optimize team resources.
• Establish meaningful performance measures and use insights to continuously strengthen team and account effectiveness.
• Provide leadership with visibility into strategic account performance, contracting activity, customer dynamics, and emerging opportunities across priority IDNs and health systems.
• Identify evolving market trends and access challenges that may impact Sobi’s portfolio and translate those insights into actionable recommendations.

External Engagement & Field Support

• Lead Corporate Account Director and cross-functional engagement at key hospital, health-system, IDN, and industry conferences and summits.
• Represent the Corporate Accounts function in senior leadership and cross-functional forums.
• Ensure relevant IDN and health-system insights are communicated to and appropriately support the U.S. field organization in a compliant manner.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on strategic account management, IDNs, hospital systems, and evolving customer dynamics.

Required

• BA/BS degree.
• 10+ years of progressive experience within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare environment.
• 5+ years of experience in IDN, hospital/health-system, Corporate Accounts, GPO, or strategic account management.
• 3+ years of people management or demonstrated leadership of field-based strategic account teams.
• Demonstrated experience navigating hospital and health-system decision-making, including formulary and access processes.
• Experience working across multiple products and/or therapeutic areas, ideally including rare or orphan diseases.
• Demonstrated success collaborating cross-functionally to develop and execute strategic account initiatives.

Preferred

• Master’s degree, MBA, or other relevant advanced degree.
• 12+ years of progressive biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare industry experience.
• Previous leadership of Corporate Account Directors, National Account Directors, or comparable field-based strategic account teams.
• Product launch experience within a multi-product or portfolio environment.
• Experience in rare disease, oncology, and/or hematology.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Proven ability to build, coach, motivate, and lead a high-performing, geographically dispersed strategic account team.
• Deep understanding of IDNs, hospital and health-system customers, strategic account management, and the evolving U.S. healthcare landscape.
• Strong business and strategic acumen with the ability to translate broader organizational priorities into actionable account plans and measurable outcomes.
• Executive-level communication, influencing, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
• Demonstrated ability to establish trusted relationships with senior health-system leaders and internal stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to use account and market data to identify opportunities and guide prioritization.
• Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations and align cross-functional stakeholders around shared objectives.
• Ability to listen to customer, field, and market feedback and translate insights into strategic action.
• Ability to lead effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing competing priorities across a national organization.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and relevant CRM, analytics, and strategic account management systems.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $250,000 - $275,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.description:
The Executive Director, Payer & Corporate Accounts is a key leadership role within U.S. Market Access, responsible for leading and integrating Sobi’s Payer Accounts and Corporate Accounts teams. This leader will shape how Sobi engages national and regional payers, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and hospital systems to help ensure patients and providers have appropriate access to Sobi’s rare disease therapies.

With responsibility spanning the Sobi portfolio, the Executive Director will establish a unified account strategy across payer and corporate customers, bringing together contracting, customer engagement, account planning, and cross-functional execution. The role will build organizational capabilities across both teams while ensuring a coordinated approach to Commercial, Medicare, hospital, and 340B-related channels.

This is an opportunity for an experienced Market Access leader to drive broad impact across Sobi’s U.S. portfolio, shape access strategy, strengthen key customer partnerships, and build high-performing teams to support patients living with rare diseases.

jobs.title: Patient Care Technician Neurosciences Intermediate Full Time Days
jobs.description:
Full Time Days 6am-6:30pm with rotating weekends

The Patient Care Tech reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Under the supervision of an RN performs basic patient care activities.

Responsibilities:

• Performs basic nursing care activities as delegated and supervised by an RN, including monitoring vital signs, taking blood glucose measurements, and recording intake and output.
• Assists patients with tending to personal care and activities of daily living, including bathing, grooming and eating.
• Reports abnormal findings or changes in physical, mental and emotional conditions to nursing staff.
• Assists with keeping patient rooms clean and orderly.
• Demonstrates flexibility, organization, and multi-tasking. Able to function under stressful situations.
• Utilizes critical thinking skills to successfully demonstrate the ability to prioritize and complete unit work quickly as the needs of the unit, patients and staff change.
• Serves as liaison between patient care units and all other patient related departments.
• Answers telephone, intercom and call lights in a polite manner using appropriate telephone etiquette and communicates information to the appropriate staff/family/patient.
• Manages the overall unit workflow in concert with the charge RN and/or assistant manager, on an as needed basis.
• Performs pre-census and validates daily admission, discharge and census lists, on an as needed basis.

Required:

• High School Diploma or equivalent
• Certified Nursing Assistant, Certified Medical Assistant, Emergency Medical Technician, or nursing school students with one semester of clinical completed
• CPR –
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)

Preferred:

• Phlebotomy experience
• Graduate of an accredited Nursing Assistant program or Graduate of Phlebotomy course

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Medical Writer, Medical Communications & Publications
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role

The Medical Writer, Medical Communications & Publications will be responsible for developing high-quality scientific and medical communications that support the dissemination of clinical data and the medical strategy.

This role will lead and support the development of scientific publications and other Medical Affairs deliverables, translating complex clinical and scientific data into clear, accurate, and balanced scientific narratives.

The Medical Writer will collaborate closely with Medical Strategy Directors, Medical Training, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory, and other cross-functional partners, as well as external investigators, authors, and medical communications agencies when relevant.

Responsibilities

• Develop Medical Affairs materials, including slide decks, data summaries, FAQs, field medical resources, and internal scientific training materials.

• Support the development of abstracts, manuscripts, posters, oral presentations, and other publication deliverables from concept through submission and publication.

• Partner with Medical Affairs colleagues to execute global publication plans and scientific communication strategies.

• Translate complex clinical trial results and scientific information into clear, accurate, balanced, and scientifically rigorous communications.

• Conduct literature reviews and synthesize published and emerging scientific data to support publications and Medical Affairs initiatives.

• Work directly with investigators, external authors, and internal subject-matter experts to facilitate content development, review, revision, and approval.

• Review clinical data, tables, figures, statistical outputs, and source materials to ensure scientific accuracy and consistency.

• Coordinate publication and medical communication activities with internal teams and external agencies, ensuring projects meet agreed-upon timelines and quality standards.

• Maintain consistency of scientific language, data presentation, and key scientific messages across Medical Affairs communications.

• Ensure publication activities follow applicable standards and ethical principles, including Good Publication Practice (GPP) and ICMJE recommendations.

• Support congress-related Medical Affairs activities and the timely communication of new clinical and scientific data.

Requirements

• Advanced scientific or healthcare degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) preferred.

• 6+ years of relevant experience in medical writing, scientific communications, publications, Medical Affairs, or a related role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, or medical communications environment.

• Demonstrated experience developing scientific communication or medical publication materials.

• Strong understanding of clinical research and demonstrated ability to interpret and communicate clinical trial data.

• Prior experience in oncology.

• Familiarity with publication standards and authorship guidelines, including GPP and ICMJE.

• Excellent scientific writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to scientific accuracy, detail, consistency, and appropriate referencing.

• Ability to critically evaluate scientific literature, clinical data, tables, figures, and statistical outputs.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a dynamic, rapidly evolving environment.

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$145,000—$185,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@smmttx.com to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in creating and maintaining diverse environment. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Paid Social Media
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.

We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

We have offices in the NY, Philadelphia, London and Germany.  Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Supervisor, Paid Social to join our One Marketplace team to lead paid social strategy and activation for key national clients. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, client leadership, and team development, and how we approach paid social across platforms and clients.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on paid social expert who understands how to translate business and brand objectives into effective social strategies, is comfortable navigating the rapidly evolving social landscape, and enjoys developing people along the way. You are curious, solutions-oriented, and eager to bring new ideas, platforms, tools, and opportunities to the work.

This is a NY based role and we offer a hybrid work setting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute paid social strategies that align with client business, brand, and performance objectives.

• Translate client business and brand objectives into strategic, actionable paid social strategies and activation plans.

• Lead day-to-day paid social operations across assigned clients, ensuring campaigns are strategically sound, effectively executed, and continuously optimized.

• Work directly with clients and internal partners to understand objectives, communicate recommendations, and provide clear, actionable insights.

• Manage campaign activation and optimization across social platforms, including Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, X, and other emerging platforms as appropriate.

• Maintain hands-on platform expertise and stay current with evolving social capabilities, formats, targeting, measurement, and best practices.

• Analyze campaign performance and use data and insights to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and improve outcomes.

• Develop POVs, recommendations, and thought leadership that bring new ideas and perspectives to clients and the broader team.

• Partner closely with planning, investment, analytics, creative, and other agency teams to ensure paid social is integrated into the broader media strategy.

• Help establish and maintain best practices for paid social strategy, activation, measurement, and optimization.

• Mentor, train, and support junior team members, providing guidance that strengthens both their technical skills and strategic thinking.

• Contribute to the continued growth of the agency by identifying new platforms, tools, capabilities, and ways of working that can create value for our clients.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of experience in paid social media, with a strong foundation in strategy, activation, optimization, and measurement; agency experience preferred.

• Hands-on experience across major paid social platforms, including Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, X, and/or emerging platforms.

• Ability to translate client business and brand objectives into strategic, actionable paid social strategies and activation plans.

• Strong understanding of audience targeting, campaign structure, budgeting, optimization, creative formats, and measurement.

• Ability to analyze campaign performance and turn data and insights into clear recommendations and strategic actions.

• Experience managing client relationships and confidently presenting strategies, recommendations, and results.

• Ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and priorities while maintaining accuracy, attention to detail, and strong follow-through.

• Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing team members and providing guidance on both strategy and execution.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.

• Curious and proactive, with a strong interest in the evolving social media landscape, emerging platforms, and new technologies.

• A solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to take ownership, navigate challenges, and identify creative and practical solutions.

SALARY

Salary range of 75-100k, commensurate with experience. Compensation is determined on the skills, qualifications,, tenure in the industry and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position.

This is a NY based role and we offer a hybrid work setting.

CROSSMEDIA BENEFITS

Our principles of Trust, Reason, and the Pursuit of Happiness are brought to life through benefits that recognize and support the diversity and physical, emotional, and professional well-being of our people, including:

• Flexibility to work in hybrid manner with in-office and work from home options (depending on role).

• Sponsored healthcare options and agency-wide physical & mental health support

• 401k with company match (USA), and generous Pension (UK)

• Life milestone recognition & support

• Student Loan payment plan (US)

• And burgers – lots and lots of burgers

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Diversity is in our DNA. As a minority-owned company, our commitment to an inclusive environment has long been embedded into agency practices and at every level. Almost one third of senior leadership identifies as a person of color and over half of our executive leadership are women. We have active mentoring & internship programs that create opportunities for underrepresented groups. Internal agency programming is anchored by XMEquity365, a permanent, year-round initiative fostering acknowledgement and support of marginalized communities within five pillars – Excellence, Voices, Education, Giving & Representation.
