jobs.title: Build Engineer, Large Scale Machining
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role

Hadrian is looking for a Build Engineer, Large Scale Machining to own how our largest machined parts get made, including castings, forgings, plate weldments, and hull-scale structures. You will own each part from the first design review through qualification, ramp, and handoff to standard production. You are the bridge between the product and Capability Engineering: you interpret the product requirements, drive DFM, establish the build flow and sequence, and hand Capability Engineering a well-defined machining problem to solve.

You will own new product and new process introduction for large machined parts end-to-end. Large parts are where precision gets hard: tight features are spread across multiple setups, and a datum scheme has to survive stress relief, flips, and weld. You set how each part flows through the factory, define the machining processes it needs, and work across Design, Supply Chain, Capability Engineering, Tooling, Quality, and Operations to bring it to rate. Decisions made during NPI set the cost, lead time, and quality of these parts for their life, and the processes you introduce become large-format machining capabilities Hadrian uses on the programs that follow.

This role sits on the Build Engineering Commodities team alongside sheet metal and tube and pipe. It is hands-on. You will be at the machine for first parts, and you will own the outcome.



What You’ll Do

 - Interpret and define product requirements from customer specifications, drawings, and contract requirements, and translate them into machining requirements, critical characteristics, and inspection needs.

 - Reverse engineer parts and assemblies where technical data is incomplete or legacy, to establish design intent, critical features, and a buildable sequence.

 - Review models and drawings for machinability at scale, including casting stock allowance, datum structure, tolerance stack across setups, tool and probe access, and distortion risk, and drive changes before design freeze.

 - Own the end-to-end machining route (rough, stress relief, semi-finish, finish, and inspection), including handoffs to weld, cladding, and assembly.

 - Set the setup count, where datums are established and carried forward, and where match-machining with mating assemblies is required.

 - Define the high-level process for each operation (envelope, critical features, material condition, cycle time against rate, and inspection approach) and hand it to Capability Engineering complete and on time.

 - Define lift points, handling, and part flow through the factory so rigging and logistics can plan around the part.

 - Own design intent for large-part fixtures, workholding, lift fixtures, and inspection aids, partnering with Tooling Engineering on detailed design and build.

 - Provide setup sheets, datum schemes, and critical-feature intent to CNC Programming.

 - Build and maintain BOM structures, work orders, and Opus work instructions in Hadrian's PLM, ERP, and MES systems, and own engineering change and configuration control as the design matures.

 - Recommend make/buy decisions, write technical packages for buy parts, and own both paths when a program runs them in parallel.

 - Plan and execute subscale development articles and full-scale qualification builds, including alternate-material development where it buys down risk, and own first article delivery.

 - Own disposition and root cause for new-product non-conformances, and drive corrective action into the design, the plan, or the process.



What We’re Looking For

 - 5+ years of experience in build, manufacturing, or production engineering with direct ownership of large machined parts (roughly 2 m and up, castings, forgings, or heavy weldments) from requirements through production.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Experience interpreting and defining product requirements from customer specifications, drawings, and contract quality clauses, and translating them into build requirements.

 - Strong GD&T and tolerance-stack skills across multi-setup parts, with a proven datum strategy.

 - Working knowledge of large-format machining (horizontal boring mills, gantry and bridge mills, large 5-axis machining centers, and VTLs) and large-part metrology, deep enough to drive DFM and set the build flow.

 - Experience reverse engineering parts or assemblies from incomplete technical data, legacy drawings, or physical parts.

 - Experience structuring BOMs, work orders, and work instructions in PLM, ERP, or MES systems, including engineering change and configuration management.

 - Proficiency in 3D CAD.

 - Comfort operating hands-on on the factory floor and making sound decisions under schedule pressure.

 - Able to work on-site at our [site] factory.



What Will Set You Apart

 - Hands-on experience running or programming large-format machines, including reading and critiquing CNC toolpaths.

 - Experience with distortion control on large parts, including stress relief sequencing, stock strategy, and thermal effects.

 - Experience with difficult materials such as Monel and other nickel-copper alloys, stainless steel, dissimilar-metal joints, and cladded surfaces.

 - Exposure to weld qualification (PQR/WPS) where machined features meet weld joints.

 - Background in aerospace, defense, naval, or energy programs with first article and customer source inspection.

 - Experience standing up a new cell or factory while the product was still in development.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role (What you'll be doing)

We're looking for a Senior Procurement Specialist to own sourcing, supplier, and category strategy across Eucalyptus AU's product categories as the business scales and integrates the Hims and Hers portfolio into the Australian market.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you are the category strategist for procurement, not just executing tenders, but designing the category strategy, running supplier performance, and partnering with Commercial and Clinical to bring new product lines to market. The role reports to the Head of Supply Chain and works closely with the Warehouse and Inventory Manager, the Fulfilment function, Legal and Compliance, and the Commercial team.

Commercial strategy is set by the Commercial team; this role builds an aligned category strategy on top of it. You'll also get an initial, lightweight S&OP cadence going, laying the groundwork for a dedicated planning hire in future rather than permanently owning that function.

As our Senior Procurement Specialist, you will:

• Build the category strategy in partnership with Commercial: translate the commercial strategy into an aligned sourcing and negotiation strategy across Eucalyptus AU's product categories, defining the negotiation levers that secure competitive landed costs and leveraging Hims and Hers' global supplier relationships for Australian requirements.

• Kick-start the S&OP process: stand up an initial, lightweight sales and operations planning cadence anchored on supplier performance and cost/margin tracking, use the demand and supply signals this generates to sharpen supplier negotiations, and progressively bring in inventory and other planning inputs as the team grows, laying the groundwork for a dedicated planning function in future.

• Own supplier performance and quarterly business reviews: run structured QBRs with strategic suppliers, set and track performance scorecards across quality, service, cost, and lead-time, and lead formal performance improvement plans where suppliers fall short.

• Partner with Commercial and Clinical on new product lines: own the procurement and supply side of bringing new categories to market, including TGA/ARTG registration readiness, supplier onboarding, and launch stock planning.

• Design the supply-risk framework and own COGS: build the framework for identifying and mitigating supply risk across categories and maintain a current, SKU-level view of landed cost, proactively identifying opportunities to protect margin as the portfolio grows.

• Design the contract and compliance framework with Legal: establish contracting standards and templates in partnership with Legal and Compliance, and ensure all products meet Australian labelling and ARTG-compliant requirements, with import duties, customs, and biosecurity obligations managed for inbound product.

• Coach the team: as the senior IC in procurement, coach more junior team members, practise radical candour, and set the quality standard for how the function sources and contracts.

About you (Who you are)

• 6+ years in procurement or strategic sourcing, ideally within FMCG, pharma, healthcare, or another regulated consumer-goods environment, with a track record of owning a category end-to-end.

• A proven commercial negotiator who has designed and delivered category strategies and measurable savings, not just run tenders under a defined process.

• Experienced in running supplier QBRs and leading structured performance improvement, with a partnership approach to key suppliers.

• Working knowledge of Australian import, labelling, and regulatory requirements; TGA/ARTG familiarity is highly desirable.

• Comfortable designing frameworks (supply-risk, contracting standards, sourcing strategy) in partnership with Legal and Compliance, rather than only operating within frameworks others have set.

• A self-starter and strong cross-functional partner, able to translate commercial strategy into an aligned category plan and stand up an S&OP cadence from scratch.

• Analytical and fluent with cost and margin data; ERP and procurement system experience is advantageous.

• A natural coach who raises the quality bar for those around them and models inclusion.

• Resilient and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-scaling, post-acquisition environment as the product portfolio and supplier base evolve.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: User Growth Regional Lead
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re looking for a Growth Regional Lead who is resourceful, data-driven, and excited about getting things done. You'll be responsible for managing product roll-outs and supervising user growth activities throughout our field locations as we rapidly scale our business in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

In this role you’ll;

• Manage a team of supervisors who in turn, manage field-based promoters

• Identify and find solutions to critical blockers for user growth and maintain active usage of our financial products in assigned areas

• Hire, train and manage distribution team members and build systems to rapidly scale distribution as needed

• Build the roadmap for the distribution team in your area to achieve its quarterly key objectives, including iterating on a strategy based on growing our customer base day after day within an assigned region of the DRC.

jobs.title: Engineer, Manager - MRB/Sustainment
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Air Dominance and Strike Aerostructures Engineering Team is responsible for designing and analyzing advanced structural parts for Group 5 air vehicles and missile platforms. Air Dominance and Strike Structures Engineers own the full development lifecycle, from conceptual to detailed design and analysis of primary and secondary structures, ensuring high-performance, resilient, and scalable mechanical systems that meet the demands of complex, contested environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead and grow a team of MRB analysis and sustainment design engineers responsible for dispositioning non-conformances and releasing repair solutions for metallic and composite structures on Group 5 air vehicles

• Own the end-to-end health of the MRB system — from non-conformance intake and structural substantiation through repair drawing release and production closure — ensuring the team meets schedule, quality, and airworthiness requirements

• Hire, mentor, and develop analysis and design engineers, including establishing a path to MRB signature/delegated authority for team members

• Set technical standards and review complex or high-risk dispositions and repair designs, acting as an escalation point for the most difficult non-conformances

• Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Engineering, Design, Materials & Processes (M&P), and Program Management to prioritize work, resolve cross-functional blockers, and protect production schedule

• Drive root cause and corrective action (RCCA) programs to reduce recurring non-conformances, rework, and scrap across the production line

• Build and continuously improve MRB processes, tools, and standard work to scale the team as production rates increase

• Report on team throughput, non-conformance trends, and open risk to engineering and program leadership

• Balance team workload across analysis and design disciplines, ensuring tight hand-offs between disposition and repair drawing release

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of experience in aerospace structural analysis, design, or liaison engineering, with direct MRB or non-conformance disposition experience

• 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineers, either as a people manager or in a senior technical leadership capacity

• Strong understanding of structural substantiation (static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance) and structural repair design for metallic and composite structures

• Demonstrated ability to set technical standards and review others' work across both analysis and design disciplines

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to represent the team to Quality, Manufacturing, Program Management, and senior engineering leadership

• Self-driven with strong autonomy and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Ability to travel up to 25% to vendors, production, and test sites as needed to support hardware builds and troubleshoot issues directly

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior MRB signature/delegated authority on a production aerospace program

• Experience standing up or scaling an MRB function in a high-rate or rapidly scaling production environment

• Familiarity with military airworthiness and structural substantiation standards (e.g., MIL-HDBK-5, MIL-STD-1530)

• Experience with both finite element analysis tools (NASTRAN or equivalent) and CAD/repair drawing tools (Siemens NX or equivalent)

• Background in design-for-manufacturability, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement for complex assemblies

• Broad experience across a range of aircraft or missile programs

• Hands-on experience in an aircraft manufacturing or depot repair environment

US Salary Range

$191,000—$254,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior OT Engineer
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

As part of the Engineering organization, Instrumentations & Controls designs the systems that monitor, automate, and protect Valar's facilities and reactor technologies. The team develops reliable control architectures that enable safe and efficient operations.

The Role

Valar Atomics is a young startup that turns ambitious engineering into working hardware. Before our third anniversary, we designed, built, commissioned, and operated a DOE-authorized research reactor outside the national laboratory system. That pace defines how we work: learn quickly, make sound decisions, and build systems that perform. Analysis must lead to decisions and delivery, and we expect people to take ownership and see their work through. If you want hard problems, real responsibility, and the freedom to build with urgency, bring your judgment and drive to Valar.

Take a defined implementation or testing objective through planning, execution, troubleshooting, and verified delivery. Own the result for assigned systems, making sound decisions within established standards and resolving interface issues with other engineers. Deep specialists and capable generalists are both welcome; this role rewards hands-on results.

OT Engineering delivers power and rack infrastructure, compute, networks, identity, security (physical & cyber), operational data, and industrial software platforms (FactoryTalk). The FactoryTalk scope covers backend deployment, configuration, integration, and recovery. PLC programming and controls-code development are outside this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Turn defined objectives into practical implementation or test plans covering prerequisites, equipment or configuration needs, dependencies, tests, and recovery steps.

• Independently implement and operate systems, or prepare, execute, and diagnose system tests within the assigned scope.

• Diagnose difficult faults using measurements, logs, test results, and system behavior; verify that corrective action resolves the problem.

• Plan and execute commissioning, failure, and recovery tests with clear acceptance criteria.

• Resolve integration issues with other engineers and identify when requirements or designs need revision.

• Complete delivery with accurate configurations, executable procedures, test evidence, and usable handoff records.

• Travel to our Torrance facility approximately 15% of the time.

You Will Be Successful in This Role If

• Highly organized, with disciplined task tracking, accurate documentation, clear priorities, and reliable follow-through.

• Independent progress from a defined objective to a working, verified result, with timely escalation of design or scope decisions.

• Strong depth in one or more disciplines and enough interface awareness to work effectively with other specialists.

• Persistent troubleshooting that follows the evidence and verifies the result instead of stopping at an apparent fix.

Basic Qualifications

• Independently deliver an implementation or rigorous hands-on test work package from a defined objective to verified completion.

• Plan methods, interfaces, dependencies, resources, testing, and turnover within established standards.

• Diagnose causes using measurements or recorded evidence; verify that corrective actions resolve the problem.

• Maintain controlled configurations and usable records; coordinate interfaces and escalate decisions beyond authority.

• Meet all requirements above and demonstrate at least one specialty below. These are alternatives; expertise across every specialty is not required.

• Power distribution and backup: Determine loads/ratings; configure and troubleshoot PDU/ATS/UPS systems; verify transfer, backup power, and recovery.

• Racks and cabling: Plan rack/cable installations, select compatible components, diagnose physical faults, and verify completed work.

• Compute, storage, and virtualization: Deploy and operate compute, storage, or virtualization; diagnose failures and prove restoration and availability.

• Industrial software backends: Deploy, integrate, troubleshoot, and recover FactoryTalk or equivalent industrial backends and supporting services.

• Networking: Configure and troubleshoot switching, routing, segmentation, and firewalls; verify connectivity, redundancy, and restoration.

• Technical documentation: Author usable procedures and records backed by exceptional hands-on testing: independently develop methods, prepare setups, execute tests, diagnose failures, and verify corrective results.

• Windows domain administration: Administer Active Directory and Group Policy; troubleshoot DNS/time dependencies and verify changes and recovery.

• Access control: Implement and troubleshoot roles, privileged access, and service-account permissions; review access and verify least privilege.

• Central logging and authentication: Integrate logging or authentication services; diagnose dependencies and verify collection, access, retention, and recovery.

• Log and packet analysis: Correlate logs and packets across systems, establish causes, and verify corrective actions.

• Operational data systems: Deploy and operate historians, databases, or interfaces; diagnose quality failures and verify retention, buffering, access, and recovery.

• Travel to our Orangeville, UT facility approximately 15% of the time.

Preferred Skills and Experience

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Own the fuel program's daily OT work plan, team workload, and delivery commitments at our Orangeville site. Keep local installation, testing, and maintenance aligned with manufacturing needs and dependable handoffs with the Torrance team. Technical expertise is preferred, not required; people-management and decision authority develop through explicit delegation.

OT Engineering delivers power and rack infrastructure, compute, networks, identity, security, operational data, and industrial software platforms. FactoryTalk scope covers backend deployment, configuration, integration, and recovery.

Key Responsibilities

• Set local priorities and maintain a realistic work plan around manufacturing needs, maintenance demands, site resources, and delivery commitments.

• Assign work, set clear expectations, coach team members, give candid feedback, and address missed commitments within delegated authority.

• Coordinate installation, testing, maintenance, and vendor activities with production and engineering stakeholders.

• Arrange specialist support across Orangeville and Torrance, with clear task ownership, prerequisites, and handoffs.

• Maintain as built structured cabling drawings for site and fuel network systems

• Maintain accurate status, issue records, and completion evidence; resolve obstacles and escalate site constraints promptly.

• Obtain required engineering and acceptance decisions, then carry work through testing, documentation, and operational turnover.

You Will Be Successful in This Role If

• Highly organized, with disciplined task tracking, accurate documentation, clear priorities, and reliable follow-through.

• Calm, practical direction when production needs, maintenance demands, or site priorities change.

• Consistent coaching, candid feedback, and fair accountability that build dependable local execution.

• Highly proficient in contractor management and leading a team that is majority contractors for a time

• Reliable cross-site communication that keeps work moving and preserves ownership through handoffs.

• Practical judgment in balancing installation, maintenance, and production support while maintaining agreed priorities.

Basic Qualifications

• Direct people-management or supervisory experience, including assignments, expectations, coaching, feedback, and accountability for completion.

• Experience coordinating concurrent technical or operational work involving specialists, vendors, resources, schedules, and dependencies.

• Ability to maintain clear priorities, realistic work plans, accurate status and issue records, and dependable follow-through under pressure.

• Experience removing delivery obstacles, escalating consequential issues, and coordinating handoffs against engineers' requirements and acceptance decisions within delegated authority.

• Coordinate local installation, maintenance, testing, and documentation with dependable production-facing and cross-site handoffs.

• Technical specialization is preferred, not required. Qualified nontechnical people managers are eligible; hands-on engineering execution is not required.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience managing infrastructure or technical services in manufacturing or other production environments.

• Experience planning installation or maintenance work in a quality-controlled operating environment.

• Familiarity with industrial OT infrastructure or coordination of local teams with remote specialists.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Platform (Runtime & Stateful Systems)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced engineering leader to own one of the most critical areas within Platform: the runtime and stateful systems Sentry runs on. You'll lead multiple engineering teams and Staff engineers responsible for OLTP and OLAP databases, real-time compute and stream processing, blob storage, and distributed caching.



These systems power Sentry's products, including Seer, and are mission-critical to the business. When they perform well, every product team moves faster. When they don't, the whole company feels the impact.



You'll set the technical vision across these systems, lead significant architectural changes, and develop the engineering leaders and teams responsible for building and operating them. This role requires someone who brings deep technical judgment, thinks strategically, and has a track record of driving complex engineering initiatives from concept through execution.



You'll have the opportunity to shape both the technical direction and organizational growth of a critical part of Sentry's platform as our products and infrastructure continue to evolve.



This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an expectation of working from our San Francisco office three days per week.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Lead multiple engineering teams and Staff engineers responsible for the runtime and stateful systems supporting Sentry, Seer, and the products built on top of them.

 - Set the technical vision and strategy across multiple systems, identifying opportunities to evolve our architecture as the business scales.

 - Drive significant architectural changes and technical initiatives, making informed tradeoffs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and complexity.

 - Provide technical leadership across teams, working closely with senior engineers to evaluate architectural decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish technical direction.

 - Own the execution and operational excellence of mission-critical systems, ensuring teams deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing platform components.

 - Build and develop a strong engineering organization, including hiring, mentoring, and growing engineering managers and senior technical leaders.

 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, technical accountability, and continuous improvement.

 - Partner across Platform, Infrastructure, and Product to align priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver complex, cross-functional initiatives.

 - Anticipate evolving product and infrastructure needs, identifying opportunities to build new platform capabilities and improve existing systems.
   
   


YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy solving complex distributed systems problems and have strong opinions about architecture, backed by experience and sound technical judgment.

 - Thrive in roles where you're equally responsible for technical direction, execution, and developing engineering leaders.

 - Like taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, establishing a clear strategy, and bringing teams together to execute.

 - Are passionate about building large-scale systems where reliability, performance, and efficiency directly impact the business.

 - Enjoy partnering with senior engineers, challenging technical assumptions, and helping teams make thoughtful architectural decisions.

 - Take pride in building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and raising the engineering bar.

 - Want to shape the runtime foundation supporting Sentry's products and AI capabilities for years to come.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 12+ years of experience in backend, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.

 - Director-level engineering management experience, or equivalent senior engineering leadership experience overseeing multiple teams at comparable scale and complexity.

 - Deep technical expertise in at least one of the following domains:
   
   - OLTP databases
   
   - OLAP databases
   
   - Real-time compute and stream processing
   
   - Blob/object storage
   
   - Distributed caching

 - Demonstrated experience driving significant architectural changes, including evaluating technical tradeoffs, establishing direction, and leading implementation.

 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply in architectural discussions across multiple distributed systems domains.

 - Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from strategy through execution, with measurable technical or business impact.

 - Experience hiring, developing, and leading engineering managers and senior technical talent.

 - Strong communication and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts, influence senior stakeholders, and align teams around a shared strategy.

 - Experience operating mission-critical infrastructure with a strong understanding of reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.



The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $300,000 to $450,000 USD, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary. A successful candidate’s actual base salary amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits https://sentry.io/careers/ for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AT SENTRY

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Upsell
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

As an Account Executive on our customer expansion team, you’ll help existing Steer customers get more value from our platform. This is a full-cycle sales role: you’ll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You’ll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you’ll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We’re looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

The role is remote.
Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Learn each shop’s goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.

• Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.

• Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.

• Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

What You Bring

Required

• Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.

• Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.

• Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

• The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.

• Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.

• A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.

• Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.

• Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

Interview Process

• Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

• Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

• Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

• Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

• Reference checks

Benefits

• 100% remote

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance

• Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum

• Generous parental leave

• FSA and HSA

• Employee Assistance Program

• 401(k)

• Learning stipend

• Work-from-home equipment

• Opportunities for career growth and development

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT HUD

HUD https://www.hud.ai/'s mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to design and build experiences across HUD’s products. You’ll help people create and evaluate environments, understand how agents behave, improve training data, and use the results to decide what to do next. These workflows can be technically dense; your work will make them clear without hiding the details that matter.

You’ll talk with users, work closely with research and engineering, and ship interfaces that improve through use and feedback. The role calls for both practical execution and a point of view: choices about what to show, how to explain results, and where to give people control will shape how humans work with increasingly capable AI agents.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build interfaces across HUD’s platform and marketplace, from early concepts through shipped product

 - Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback understandable and actionable

 - Work with research and engineering to turn complex RL and evaluation workflows into useful tools

 - Talk with users, observe where they struggle, and use what you learn to improve the product

 - Develop thoughtful interaction patterns and maintain a high bar for usability, visual quality, and implementation


EXPERIENCE

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Strong product and interaction design judgment, especially for complex tools or workflows

 - Front-end engineering skills and the ability to turn your designs into working product interfaces

 - A record of shipping products, learning from users, and improving what you built

 - The ability to understand technical concepts well enough to present them clearly to users

 - Good judgment about when to ship quickly and when an experience needs more care

 - Clear communication and comfort working closely with engineers, researchers, and users

Strong candidates may also have:

 - Experience designing developer tools, data-rich products, or research software

 - Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, or training data

 - Experience creating reusable interface patterns as a product grows

 - Experience working independently in an early-stage company

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.


TEAM & COMPANY DETAILS

 - Team Size: ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.

 - Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), the former #1 ranked Catan player in the world, serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.

jobs.title: Community Communications Lead
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Product & Research Communications team helps people understand our technology, what it makes possible, and how to use it. We bring new products and research to the world and tell stories about the people making these tools their own.

We work closely with our Culture & Community Engagement team to connect our products with people’s interests, ambitions, and everyday lives. Together, we help more people discover what they can create, learn, and do with AI—and bring their experiences back into how we communicate.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Community Communications Lead to bring OpenAI’s products closer to communities and help their stories reach a wider audience. Sitting on the Product & Research Communications team, you’ll work hand in hand with the Culture & Community team to shape narratives, develop earned media opportunities, and amplify community-driven stories across organic communications channels.

You’ll be involved from the beginning of campaigns and community programs, bringing ideas that strengthen the story, cultural relevance, and opportunities for participation. Working closely with Culture & Community Engagement leaders, you’ll contribute communications strategy while respecting their ownership of campaign and creative decisions.

You’ll also connect individual campaigns, partnerships, and community moments into a broader story that develops over time. You’ll have the judgment to know when the work has earned a larger conversation—and the relationships and storytelling skills to make it happen.

We’re looking for someone with cultural curiosity, strong editorial taste, initiative, judgment and an entrepreneurial approach. You understand what makes people care and how community trust is built. You keep our claims grounded, can navigate skepticism about AI and understand how a story can invite people to take part.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Be in the room as we shape the narrative. Help develop the story, cultural angle and earned comms opportunity from the beginning. Bring ideas that make the campaign itself stronger.

 - Think beyond a campaign to connect the multiple beats/campaigns into one overarching narrative for our Culture & Community Engagement team that resonates with press and creators. 

 - Help AI move from subculture into pop and mass culture. Have the instincts and relationships to reach people through sport, music, design, food, fandom, etc. Understand what makes those audiences care and where they get their information. Build relationships with journalists, creators and cultural voices.

 - Find the stories inside our communities. Work closely with the community team to surface compelling builders, small businesses, students and unexpected people making the tools their own. Help them tell stories in their own voices, grounded in what they’re trying to achieve.

 - Make participation part of the story. A big ambition for us is giving people and communities things to create, learn and do together. Understand how storytelling can invite more people into that experience and how community contributions become the next chapter.

 - Sustain an ongoing narrative. Build a rhythm of stories across creator campaigns, community programs and partnerships. Keep the work interesting over months, through earned media and OpenAI’s communications channels.

 - Develop pitches, features, spokesperson opportunities, and channel content that connect individual stories to a larger narrative, supported by the work and its results.

 - Connect the work globally. Partner with regional comms and our territory leads so we have a clear shared story with locally relevant voices and cultural angles, supported by local examples.

 - Bring community perspectives and feedback into product communications planning, helping the team understand what resonates, what needs explanation, and where new stories are emerging.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience leading communications for consumer brands, cultural campaigns, creator initiatives, or community programs, with a track record of earning meaningful attention.

 - Have strong cultural instincts and relationships beyond technology media. You understand what different audiences care about, whom they trust, and where they get their information.

 - Are an excellent writer and editor who can find the larger story across several moments without losing the details that make each one distinctive.

 - Bring ideas early, have a clear point of view, and make work stronger through thoughtful collaboration. You can influence a direction while respecting others’ decision-making responsibilities.

 - Know how to work with community members and creators so their stories feel authentic, reflect their goals, and preserve their voices.

 - Think beyond announcements. You can build a narrative over months and recognize when there is enough substance for a deeper story.

 - Combine creative ambition with strong organization and follow-through. You can manage multiple programs, work independently, and adapt quickly as priorities change.

 - Build trusted relationships across communications, community, marketing, product, and regional teams.

 - Are curious about AI and how people use it, with a commitment to communicating both its possibilities and limitations accurately.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.


Job Description

Reporting to the US Design Director, we are looking for an Senior Motion Designer who is conceptually-minded and craft-forward. You’ll be leading motion design work for some of the world’s greatest brands – with a focus on a large client undergoing a brand reinvention. You’re an expert in leading design and motion design tools like Figma and After Effects (and even some 3D tools) but have also started to bring the latest AI tools into your craft and you’re excited about how you can blend these two things going forward.  You'll excel in a dynamic, international environment – working across teams in the US, UK, and Mexico. You’re obsessed with design, and brands who put movement at their heart of everything they do. You’ll work hands-on, but also be a motion design leader across the global agency.

Responsibilities

 - Drive the Motion Design craft across all projects - leveling up all work across traditional and AI-forward projects.

 - Strive to deliver award-winning motion design whilst ensuring that all work strongly delivers against the brief and client and business objectives.

 - Work hands-on in design tools like Figma and After Effects and by leveraging the latest GenAI tools where appropriate.

 - Work directly with the Design Director, US to level up the design practice at Jellyfish

 - Collaborate with team of designers in the US and Mexico daily - helping lead some projects as well as providing oversight for more junior team members.

 - Contribute to fast moving new business pitches

 - Be a strong creative voice for design in general - and how we can be more motion-forward in all of the design work we deliver to our clients.

 - Regularly share your team’s latest creative work with your Design Director and VP Creative, working closely for development and sign off.

 - Build relationships and influence with designers in the US, UK and Mexico.

 - Create groundbreaking visual ideas to promote brand engagement.

 - Defend and improve ideas in response to client feedback

 - Review work with the Design Director, Creative VP and ECD, take feedback and action their direction across the team.

Skills and Competencies

 - Creative Agency Experience: 6+ years in a motion design role at top advertising agency and/or design studio

 - Craft excellence: Proven track record of creating high-craft client work.

 - Embrace of AI’s creative potential: Enthusiasm for the use of AI in creative work (where appropriate) - supported by a strong background and commitment to creative craft.

 - Trends & Culture: Expertise and continued awareness across digital, social, AI tools and emerging advertising trends.

 - Strong Communication: Excellent team and client communication and presentation skills.

 - Global expertise: Experience working with global brands on high-profile, heart-of-culture campaigns.

 - Hands-on approach: With tools such as the full Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Google suite, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Nano Banana and other AI-driven creative solutions.



Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.


Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritize your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs

🏥 Healthcare plans: Have peace of mind with our healthcare, vision and dental insurance, plus short and long-term disability and life cover.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers.

jobs.title: Senior UXUI designers
jobs.description:
Senior UX/UI Product Designer

We are looking for an exceptional Senior UX/UI Product Designer with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience, a strong visual design foundation, and extensive experience designing consumer-facing mobile applications at scale.

Mobile product design is our highest priority. We want designers who have created outstanding experiences for native iOS and Android applications—not simply responsive websites or desktop applications adapted to smaller screens.

This is not a role for junior designers or candidates who require heavy direction and micromanagement.

We are looking for experienced, independent designers who:

• Think in systems, not just individual screens.
• Have exceptional visual taste, typography, composition, and interaction design skills.
• Understand consumer engagement, retention, discovery, and user behavior.
• Can own major product areas from concept through implementation.
• Can evaluate existing designs, identify weaknesses, and raise the visual quality of an entire product.
• Move quickly, communicate clearly, and thrive in entrepreneurial startup environments.

You will work directly with company leadership, our existing UX/UI designers, and engineering teams to shape the core experiences of OleOle, including:

• Microblogging and personalized social feeds.
• Messaging, group chats, and mobile voice and video calls.
• TikTok-style short-form video, discovery, and creation.
• Live football scores and match experiences.
• Football history, statistics, and discovery.
• Mobile onboarding, club and country identity, and fan engagement.

What You Will Do

• Lead UX/UI design for major product experiences across native iOS, Android, web, and tablets, with a strong emphasis on mobile.
• Create exceptional mobile interfaces with intuitive navigation, polished interactions, strong typography, thoughtful animation, and visual consistency.
• Design sophisticated consumer experiences that bring multiple capabilities together without overwhelming users.
• Develop user journeys, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and production-ready high-fidelity designs.
• Help establish and evolve a unified design system across OleOle’s interconnected products.
• Review existing designs, identify opportunities for improvement, and help elevate the work of other designers.
• Collaborate directly with frontend engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and perform well across devices.
• Think deeply about consumer psychology, engagement, usability, retention, and interaction patterns.
• Contribute to product direction, not simply execute assigned design tasks.
• Help establish long-term design quality standards and a culture of exceptional product craftsmanship.

What We’re Looking For

Required qualifications

• Minimum 7 years of professional UX/UI or product design experience.
• Substantial hands-on experience designing consumer-facing native iOS and Android applications.
• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design quality in shipped mobile products.
• Strong foundations in graphic design, typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
• Deep understanding of mobile navigation, gestures, interaction patterns, transitions, and platform conventions.
• Experience designing complex consumer products with multiple interconnected features.
• Strong experience developing and maintaining scalable design systems.
• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, and interactive prototyping.
• Understanding of user psychology, engagement, retention, and product usability.
• Experience collaborating directly with frontend engineers and product teams.
• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make sound design decisions without constant supervision.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and design critique skills.

Highly relevant product experience

We are particularly interested in designers who have worked on:

• Social networking and community applications.
• Messaging and communication platforms.
• Short-form video and creator applications.
• Sports, gaming, and entertainment platforms.
• Consumer marketplaces and high-engagement commerce applications.
• Mobile applications serving millions of users.

We value exceptional consumer product design experience even if you have never worked in football.

Design Leadership and Ownership

While this is a hands-on senior design position, we are looking for someone capable of helping strengthen the overall design organization.

You should be comfortable:

• Taking ownership of complex product experiences.
• Critiquing and improving existing UX/UI designs.
• Mentoring and collaborating with other designers.
• Establishing consistent visual and interaction standards.
• Working directly with leadership to translate product vision into exceptional user experiences.

We are not looking for someone who only creates wireframes, conducts research, or maintains Figma libraries. We need designers who can produce beautiful, intuitive, production-ready consumer products.

Huge Plus

• Passion for football and global sports culture.
• Experience designing social feeds, messaging, or short-form video applications.
• Strong motion design and micro-interaction capabilities.
• Experience designing products from zero to one.
• Experience improving existing consumer products through major redesigns.
• Experience with multilingual, international consumer applications.
• Experience working in fast-moving, early-stage startups.

Portfolio Requirements

A portfolio demonstrating outstanding mobile product design is required.

We want to see actual iOS and Android product experiences, including:

• High-fidelity mobile screens demonstrating strong visual design.
• Navigation systems, user flows, and interaction patterns.
• Examples of complex consumer experiences made intuitive and visually compelling.
• Clear explanations of your personal design ownership and contributions.

Generic enterprise dashboards, templated SaaS designs, wireframe-only portfolios, or portfolios without substantial mobile work will not be considered a strong fit.

What You Need to Know About Compensation

OleOle is currently a pre-funding startup. This position operates under a deferred-compensation structure until financing is secured.

Compensation accrues during the pre-funding period and becomes payable following a successful funding event, subject to the terms of the agreement.

Our compensation structure includes:

• Deferred compensation: Accrued during the pre-funding period, with payment contingent on successful funding and the agreement terms.
• Post-funding salary: Transition to a competitive, market-based salary following funding.
• Equity ownership: An opportunity to participate in OleOle’s long-term growth through company equity.
• OleX tokens: Additional token-based ownership participation in the OleOle ecosystem.

Our entire team, including company leadership, engineers, designers, and product specialists, is currently operating under the same deferred-compensation model.

We believe in being completely transparent: startup fundraising involves risk, financing is not guaranteed, and deferred compensation may never become payable if funding is not secured.

We’re looking for entrepreneurial designers who understand that risk and are excited by the opportunity to help build a global consumer technology platform from the ground up.

This is an opportunity to join OleOle at an early stage, take meaningful ownership of major product experiences, and contribute to the creation of a platform designed to connect football fans around the world.

Compensation is deferred until we close funding. It’s not free work it’s paid post funding and includes equity and token allocation that vest

jobs.title: Senior Space Mission Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Mission Operations Engineer is an experienced spacecraft operator. They are exceptional communicators, adept leaders, and a jack-of-all trades capable of applying cross-discipline engineering to bespoke solutions. An ideal candidate is someone passionate to work in a startup environment where you will have the opportunity to fully own on-orbit operations for our Winnie Spaceship and mold a unique new mission framework for operations in space.

Responsibilities

• Develop, coordinate, execute, and lead Varda's on-orbit missions.

• Own the full ops development cycle for mission-unique payloads, from the creation of mission profiles through execution.

• Work with teams across the company to continuously improve upon mission operations and ensure mission success.

• Automate and eliminate operational burden by building webtools.

• Scale up Varda's operational capabilities to support a growing flight cadence.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, preferably Aerospace, Electrical, or Computer Science.

• 5+ years of experience in a real time operations role on a complex and high consequence operation.

• 3+ years of experience developing software tools in Python, JavaScript, and/or HTML.

• Familiarity with Avionics, GNC, Software, and Thermal design practices for spacecraft.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• 5+ years of experience with spacecraft systems.

• Previous operator experience in a leadership role.

• Previous in-orbit spacecraft operations experience.

• Previous experience with Git and Atlassian products.

• Familiarity with ground stations networks.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).
